answer: The karst graph is validated at intake and the dune frontier is published, so that the ancestry of every answer is public, and copper anchors the chain at a checkpoint. A freshly minted alias has no ancestry, so it must first attach itself to real accepted work: 145 new identities mean that many orphan roots to graft by hand rather than print, and each root still needs its own identity record. A 324 account operation therefore ties up 8 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
